description: This header defines a template class for generating uniformly distributed random integers over a specified inclusive range, including associated parameter and stream operators.

classes.name: absl::uniform_int_distribution
classes.description: Template class for generating uniform random integers within a specified range.

classes.name: absl::uniform_int_distribution::param_type
classes.description: Parameter class holding the lower and upper bounds of the distribution.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Generates a random integer using the provided generator and distribution parameters.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the distribution (no effect in this implementation).

methods.name: a
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution.

methods.name: b
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the distribution.

methods.name: param
methods.description: Gets or sets the distribution parameters.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of two distribution objects.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality of two distribution objects.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Generates a uniform random value in [0, R] using the generator.
